scope: Native Temporal SDK candidate C: two closed published-Flow compositions, durable native SkillInvocation references, asynchronous DataPrep, real service review and receipt; local qualification only

test_command.credential_substitution: Only the supplied disposable local PostgreSQL DSN is replaced by a variable name. No secret value is stored.
test_command.postgres_fixture_scope: Private per-test schemas, shared disposable server retained

qualified: Both closed compositions produce one real delivery receipt through native service qualification and human decision.
Published service_tick ingress creates a Temporal dispatch only; disabled rollout rolls back admission.
Actual RecipeExecution is queued with durable dispatch and zero pending Temporal Activities; native run_preparation executes separately.
No Activity held during human review; Temporal signal does not authorize delivery.
Real Temporal server process kill/restart preserves SQLite-backed Workflow history; a newly created SDK Worker resumes after review.
Payload marker absent from SDK Workflow history; references-only requests/results and redacted authority errors.
Concurrent PostgreSQL submission invokes provider double once; a late reply preserves a lost invocation.
Current membership and revision authority enforced; revoked permissions prevent publication.
Parent absolute deadline bounds child and outbox before dispatch; queued legacy child refuses execution after expiry.
DataPrep implicit output and explicit split port satisfy required dataset_id input and deliver the same chosen output_port; ambiguous or absent profile port rejected.
Starter reconciliation preserves prior terminal states and marks newly refused active Runs failed.
limitations: LLM agent transports are doubled. evaluate_v2 wrapper is real but its provider response and token usage are simulated; no real provider or HANA access.
SDK composition application database is SQLite. Three PostgreSQL concurrency/locking cases are separate; no claim that the entire SDK path ran over PostgreSQL.
SDK child computation invokes the native run_preparation function outside Activities after durable queueing. No real broker/Celery worker process participates in those two compositions.
Server process crash is real; SDK Worker restarts gracefully within the test process, not as a killed operating-system worker.
Closed profiles only: no general DAG, agent_loop, loop, fork, subflow or parallel branch migration.
Streaming scoring submission is implemented, but no SDK composition using a real model is qualified in this report.
Unknown provider cost remains unknown; judge subtotal does not qualify all agent calls.
Temporal dev server with persistent SQLite is not an HA or production-server qualification; no load/cost/latency claim.
Native orchestration image not built or measured here; production VM, resource envelope, live TLS/account and A/B/baseline parity remain unqualified.
No deployment, merge, production flag activation or image-budget change. General regression suite has separate evidence.
redaction: Only successful two-line pytest summary and whitelisted local runtime/cleanup metadata copied; no DSN value, credentials, application payload, provider output or environment dump.
